patthana24.3:1.1: dhammo hetussa sappaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana24.3:3.1: na hetuṃ na sanidassanaṃ dhamma paṭicca na hetu sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.3:4.1: na hetu na anidassano dhammo hetussa anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. ārammaṇe tīṇi.
patthana24.3:5.1: na hetuṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.3:6.1: na hetuṃ na appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.3:7.1: na hetuṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ na
patthana24.3:8.1: arūpī dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.3:9.1: na hetuṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na na hetuṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (gaṇitakena tīṇi.)
patthana24.3:10.1: na hetuṃ na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā nava. na hetuṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā nava. na hetuṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na hetuṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na hetuṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu āsavoca na hetu āsavoca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
patthana24.3:11.1: na na hetuṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ. na hetuṃ
patthana24.3:12.1: no āsavañca na na hetuṃ no āsavaṃ ca
